name: How long does a typical gate repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical gate repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of gate repair depends on the complexity of the problem. Simple fixes, such as adjusting alignment or replacing a small component, might take a few hours. More extensive repairs, like welding a broken frame or troubleshooting complex automatic opener issues, could take a full day or require multiple visits. We'll provide an estimated timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical gate repair time varies; simple fixes take hours, while complex repairs may take a day or more.
